name: Triptorelin
route: Depot injection into a buttock muscle every 4, 12 or 24 weeks
status: FDA-approved for advanced prostate cancer (Trelstar) and central precocious puberty from age 2 (Triptodur)
mechanism: A long-acting GnRH analog that desensitizes the pituitary after a brief surge, suppressing LH, FSH and the sex hormones they control

article.summary: Triptorelin (Trelstar, Triptodur) is a long-acting GnRH agonist injection that lowers testosterone or estrogen, approved for advanced prostate cancer and for central precocious puberty in children.
article.takeaway: Triptorelin is a long-acting version of GnRH, the brain hormone that drives the pituitary gland, injected into a buttock muscle every 4, 12 or 24 weeks. After a brief hormone surge, it desensitizes the pituitary and lowers testosterone or estrogen. In the Trelstar label trials, **91.2%** of men with advanced prostate cancer had castrate testosterone by day 29 on the monthly dose, and **97.5%** on the 6-month depot.[^1] As Triptodur it treats central precocious puberty, with 93.2% of children showing suppressed LH at six months in one trial.[^2][^3] Hot flashes, bone pain at the start and long-term metabolic effects are the main downsides.[^1]
glance: Approved: Trelstar for prostate cancer; Triptodur for central precocious puberty (age 2 and up)
Advanced prostate cancer; early puberty in children
Intramuscular depot injection by a clinician every 4, 12 or 24 weeks
Label trials in prostate cancer and puberty; used in the TEXT and SOFT breast cancer trials
Prohibited at all times in males (WADA S2.2.1)

blocks.text: The hypothalamus releases GnRH in pulses, and each pulse tells the pituitary to release LH and FSH. Triptorelin is a GnRH analog with one amino acid swapped so that it resists breakdown. Held in a slow-release depot, it stimulates the pituitary continuously. After a short rise, the receptors stop responding and sex hormone production falls.

In prostate cancer trials, average testosterone rose above baseline during the first week, then fell to baseline or below by the end of the second week. That temporary rise is the reason for the tumor flare warning.[^1]

items: **Triptodur:** central precocious puberty in children 2 years and older, a condition in which the brain starts puberty too early.[^2]

blocks.text: Triptorelin is also used to suppress the ovaries in premenopausal women with hormone-receptor-positive breast cancer, which is outside its US label.

rows: Men with advanced prostate cancer, about 120 to 170 per dose
Castrate testosterone at day 29 in 91.2% (3.75 mg), 97.7% (11.25 mg) and 97.5% (22.5 mg); 93% to 96% stayed castrate through the study[^1]
93.2% had suppressed LH at month 6 and 97.7% at month 12[^3]
Ovarian suppression used triptorelin, surgery or radiation; exemestane plus suppression beat tamoxifen plus suppression (5-year disease-free survival 91.1% vs 87.3%)[^4]

blocks.text: A clinician gives a single intramuscular injection in either buttock. Trelstar comes in three strengths: 3.75 mg every 4 weeks, 11.25 mg every 12 weeks and 22.5 mg every 24 weeks.[^1] Triptodur is 22.5 mg every 24 weeks.[^2]

items: **Men:** hot flushes, skeletal pain, impotence or erectile dysfunction, headache and testicular shrinkage. Tumor flare can cause bone pain or urinary problems early on.[^1]
**Longer-term warnings:** metabolic syndrome, cardiovascular disease, QT prolongation, convulsions and severe skin reactions.[^1]

**Children (Triptodur):** injection-site reactions, vaginal bleeding after the initial hormone rise, hot flush and headache. Labeled warnings include psychiatric events, convulsions and pseudotumor cerebri.[^2]
**Pregnancy:** Triptodur is contraindicated in pregnancy, and Trelstar carries an embryo-fetal toxicity warning.[^1][^2]

blocks.text: Both labels list an initial US approval for triptorelin in 2000.[^1][^2] The 2026 WADA Prohibited List names triptorelin among the GnRH agonists banned at all times in male athletes (S2.2.1, testosterone-stimulating peptides).[^5]

evidence.label: Strong for hormone suppression; modest direct outcome data
evidence.text: Approval rests on consistent testosterone and LH suppression in clinical studies,[^1][^3] a pattern shared by all GnRH agonists. Evidence on breast cancer recurrence comes from the TEXT and SOFT trials, where triptorelin was one of the ways to suppress the ovaries.[^4]

faq.q: How is triptorelin different from leuprolide?
faq.a: Both are GnRH agonists with the same mechanism. They differ in formulation, dosing schedule and labeled uses. [Leuprolide](/peptides/leuprolide) has more products, including injections under the skin.

faq.q: Why can symptoms get worse at the start of treatment?
faq.a: Testosterone briefly rises before it falls, which can flare bone pain or urinary symptoms in men with advanced prostate cancer.[^1]
Yes. Triptodur is approved for central precocious puberty in children 2 and older and is given every 24 weeks.[^2]
For male athletes, yes. WADA lists triptorelin as prohibited at all times.[^5]
